description: Derives a service's category label(s) from its capability flags (data/service-capability-rules.json). A service may hold MULTIPLE categories (multi-label) — a service can be both serverless_compute and own durable storage. Categories are a coarse axis the guidance KB (data/domain-mapping-guidance/<framework>.json) can override objectives on via by_service_category. Category derivation is best-effort and additive: a service with no matching signal simply gets no category, and the KB objective-level defaults apply unchanged. Consumed by scripts/compute-applicability-matrix.py.
category_note: serverless_compute: event-driven compute with no customer OS to patch (Lambda). managed_compute: compute the customer runs but AWS operates the control plane. container: container/orchestration surfaces. storage: owns durable object/file/block storage. database: owns a managed datastore with backup/PITR. networking: primary surface is a network path/endpoint. data_analytics: query/stream/ETL over data. security_identity: an identity, key, or security-tooling service. Multi-label allowed; conflicts are not resolved here — the KB decides precedence when it authors an override.

category_rules.description: Event-driven compute the customer does not patch (no customer OS). Positive signal is an execution role + emits logs WITHOUT a customer-managed-patching signal.
Compute where the customer manages OS/software patching.
Service owns durable storage the customer manages.
Service owns a managed datastore with backup / point-in-time recovery.
Service's primary surface is a network path/endpoint the customer isolates.
